main_goal.text: Implement generic Home + Article public templates in the standalone CMS Worker so a tenant content domain renders the approved 13-section Home and 12-section Article using per-site brand tokens via SiteContext, with no TheIWise visible brand and no cms.kodigital.app leak.
main_goal.action: render Home + Article templates from per-site CMS data
main_goal.storage_surface: D1 (sites, site_settings, articles, categories, site_categories, category_verticals, media, pages)
main_goal.failure_criterion: Any rendered output contains TheIWise/theiwise outside docs/reference allowlist; href="#" present in rendered home/article; section order differs from PART 1/PART 2; .article-shell omits minmax(0, 1fr); cms.kodigital.app appears in any public-domain body; any verify:* script non-zero.
